newsitem.title: USA: Home Health to acquire Eastern Shore.
newsitem.headline: Home Health to acquire Eastern Shore.

text.p: Home Health Corp of America Inc said in a statement received on Monday it signed a definitive agreement to purchase Eastern Shore Health Services Inc and Eastern Shore Private Care Inc.

The transaction in Eastern Shore Health Services and Eastern Shore Private Care -- both companies are located in Maryland and have a combined revenue of $3 million -- is expected to close within two weeks.
Home Health is a provider of comprehensive home health care services. The company owns and operates 26 branch locations in Pennsylvania as well as other U.S. states.
